title: The Live Extraction
author: Casper Almeida
blurb: Wren Amberdale, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
